patterns.message: Visual components can't talk to Supabase directly. Put data access in a hook in src/hooks/ or a -db.ts module in src/lib/.
Visual components can't import the Supabase clients. Put data access in a hook in src/hooks/ or a -db.ts module in src/lib/.
Visual components can't import data files. Put data access in a hook in src/hooks/.
Visual components can't import server-only admin/ingest code. Put it behind a hook in src/hooks/ or a route in src/app/api/.
